_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. OPMCM PMDRF Daily Deposit, 22 Bhadra 17:00 — nine-bank NPR stock Rs 8,460,662,427. Published post-flood collections Rs 7,378,240,022 plus pre-flood Rs 2,082,422,405 equal Rs 9,460,662,427 before the Rs 1,000,000,000 already released to affected areas (9,460,662,427 − 1,000,000,000 = 8,460,662,427). The nine printed bank rows sum to one rupee more than the MoF total; Global IME is carried Rs 1 lower here so the panel closes on the published total. The bulletin at nirajbhusal.github.io is someone else's aggregation; the Ministry of Finance / PMDRF figures are the source. Two rules: (1) the pre-disaster balance is already inside the 8.46 billion — never add it again; (2) name-transfer lists, NCHL, PhonePe QR, foreign pledges, in-kind cargo and the IFRC DREF are not this fund's bank stock and are never added to it. app/domains/flood/content.py re-adds the bank rows at load.

breakdowns.caption_en: Nine banks, OPMCM PMDRF Daily Deposit 22 Bhadra 17:00 = Rs 8.46 billion. Published post-flood collections Rs 7,378,240,022 plus pre-flood Rs 2,082,422,405 equal Rs 9,460,662,427 before the Rs 1 billion already released (net post-flood Rs 6,378,240,022 + pre-flood Rs 2,082,422,405 = current stock). The printed bank rows sum to one rupee more than the MoF total; Global IME is carried Rs 1 lower here so the panel closes. USD is a separate label.
breakdowns.caption_ne: नौ बैंक, प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय दैनिक जम्मा २२ भदौ १७:०० = रु. ८ अर्ब ४६ करोड। प्रकाशित विपद्पछि संकलन रु. 7,378,240,022 + मौज्दात रु. 2,082,422,405 = रु. 9,460,662,427 निकासाअघि (१ अर्ब निकासापछि नेट विपद्पछि रु. 6,378,240,022 + मौज्दात = हालको मौज्दात)। प्रकाशित बैंक पङ्क्ति योग MoF जम्माभन्दा एक रुपैयाँ बढी; ग्लोबल आइएमई यहाँ एक रुपैयाँ कम छ ताकि प्यानल बन्द होस्। डलर छुट्टै लेबल हो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The Rs 2.08 billion already in the fund is inside the 8.46 billion, not on top of it. USD 21.00 million (~Rs 3.17 billion at 150.88) is not part of the Nepali-rupee total; the 'total available' label Rs 11,628,605,003 is NPR stock plus that USD equivalent — not a second cash pile. Jensen Huang's USD 10 million is a contribution to this fund but is not yet inside the 8.46 billion cash figure. Name-transfer Rs 1.93 billion, NCHL Rs 4.26 billion, PhonePe QR Rs 2.35 billion, foreign pledges, World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC appeal are not this bank stock.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको २ अर्ब ८ करोड ८ अर्ब ४६ करोडभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर नेपाली जम्मामा होइन; 'कुल उपलब्ध' लेबल NPR + डलर समकक्ष हो, दोस्रो नगद थुप्रो होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको १ करोड डलर यही कोषमा गएको योगदान हो तर ८ अर्ब ४६ करोडको नगद अंकभित्र अझै छैन। नाम-हस्तान्तरण, NCHL, फोनपे QR, वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी अपिल यो बैंक मौज्दात होइनन्।

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m + UAE $10m + Jensen Huang $10m. These are pledges and contributions announced outside the published rupee balance, not cash counted in the Prime Minister's fund table.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि. + युएई $१० मि. + जेन्सेन ह्वाङ $१० मि.। यी प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातबाहिरका घोषणा/योगदान हुन्, कोषको तालिकामा गनिएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 8.46 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $39.59 million. ADB $5m and UAE $10m are pledges, not cash received. UAE's 83-tonne flight is inside the $10m package, not on top of it. Jensen Huang's $10m (about Rs 1.51 billion) is a contribution to the Prime Minister's fund that the published rupee balance does not yet carry — count it once, here.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ८ अर्ब ४६ करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $३९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन र युएई $१० मिलियन घोषणा हुन्, आएको नगद होइनन्। युएईको ८३ टन उडान $१० मिलियनभित्र छ, माथि होइन। जेन्सेन ह्वाङको $१० मिलियन (करिब रु. १.५१ अर्ब) प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा गएको योगदान हो जुन प्रकाशित रुपैयाँ मौज्दातले अझै समेटेको छैन — एक पटक, यहीँ गन्नुहोस्।
